question: The Clearing Corporation of India Limited (CCIL) was established in ______________.
solution: The correct answer is __**2001**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Clearing Corporation of India Limited (CCIL)** was established in the year **2001**. It was created to provide clearing and settlement services for transactions in the financial markets. • CCIL is headquartered in **Mumbai, Maharashtra, India**, and plays a crucial role in ensuring smooth functioning and stability in the Indian financial system. • The corporation primarily serves markets such as **government securities, money markets, foreign exchange (FX) markets, and derivatives**. • One of the key objectives of CCIL is to mitigate counterparty risk, which is achieved through processes such as novation and guaranteed settlement. • It operates under the regulatory oversight of the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**, ensuring compliance with financial standards and market integrity.
